item.description:
• Every account in one calm inbox: Gmail, Outlook, iCloud, Yahoo, Fastmail and any IMAP, POP3 or JMAP server
  • Triage from the keyboard with archive, snooze, pin, Reply Later, undo send and a command palette
  • Inbox split into People, Updates and Newsletters, plus rules, templates and send later
  • AI summaries, reply drafts and Ask your inbox with Apple Intelligence, Ollama, LM Studio or your own key
  • Claude, Cursor and other agents can search and draft mail through MCP, with tokens you scope
  • Your mail stays on your Mac
  • Try everything free for 14 days, then keep it with a one-time license
